name: Call Of Duty Quotes
teaser: Call Of Duty Quotes that shows up everytime you die.
description_html:
hello everyone

i think some of you know the quotes because i post it before at 3.11.4 and 2.8k people download it so i add it in addons ;) this is some of the Quotes that i gather it up from a website : https://callofduty.fandom.com/wiki/Quoted_sayings_in_the_Call_of_Duty_series

total quotes : 352 quotes

i put it all in a JSON file and make it fit that every time you die you will get a cool Quote.

be advised this will work only if you install this mod -> Headshot Darkness

example:

https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExanhubXI2czMwc2c4am05NWU4MWhqNGt5c2E1MWpsYWdhbDdrcDRuZiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/TDUNL6DR3g1fvrf1H7/giphy.gif

until next time….have a great raids ^-^
